XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Variable valve timing solenoid valve

  • Fault: Abnormal noise from the engine (knocking); the vehicle continues to run smoothly

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0009 (Engine timing/control system, bank 2 – Generic fault)

  • Cause: Phase-varying solenoid valve fouled

• Action: Check the condition of the variable valve timing solenoid valve; clean it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, between the engine and the passenger compartment, next to the air filter.

    The estimated time required for the service is approximately 0.7 h.
